redelightmap.config.title: Redelight-map
redelightmap.config.option.enabled.descr: Toggles Redelight-map's custom lightmap on and off.
redelightmap.config.option.moonPhaseDark: Adjusts amount of additional darkness from moon phases.
redelightmap.config.option.lowLightVisio: Let your eyes adapt to the dark. Allows you see a short distance in total darkness.
